fieldValues.title: Essays are browsed by domain and family, newest first, with shared paragraphs shown
fieldValues.move: A landing view lists essays by the domain each names, walking from a domain into its sub-domains, newest first. Within a domain it shows each essay's family (a copy is derived-from its original) and highlights shared paragraphs as the strongest link between two essays.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Naming the domain itself (the essay map, SP-85's remedy) and folders or a bin (SP-74).
fieldValues.falsifier: The owner opens a domain and cannot tell which essays descend from which, or which share paragraphs.
